entry_points.text: One kernfs file table routes read map poll and other requests to dedicated handlers, with read split by node capability.
Inode vector offers access and attribute handling with xattr listing; handler table with adapters resolves full names.
Fill records info geometry and root; get tree shares or fills activates and registers; kill detaches and frees; export offers encode decode.
Link read fills page buffer under read lock; cursor open allocates and close drops; removal resolves positive only then removes.

exports.text: Sequential read iterator with release and generic seek helper resolve whence against end of file within bounds.
Kernfs file creation with notify trigger and file table wiring standard methods to dedicated handlers.
Node to dentry resolution with permission bypassing positive lookup and symlink creation with inherited ownership.

hazards.text: Stalled sequential index is detected with ratelimited notice; short escape room and short name buffer signal overflow.
Map and open reject unsafe combinations; backend paths revalidate active and report absence or bus fault; permission checks can fail nonblocking.
Bounds and signals: single page direct reads, global seq maximum, end mapped holes, and bus faults for missing mapping backend.
Flags and ranges: file capability flags, deactivated bias, two word handles, and directory first to end positions with interior offsets.
Unstable parents and missing ancestors fail as invalid; dentryless link read fails; directory reads fail; unconditional helper always deletes.
External error atomic list RCU lock and utility helpers owned elsewhere are relied on for checks allocation and synchronization.

invariants.text: Direct read gives at most one page while active and moves position only after delivery; write enforces atomic or page cap with assured capture.
Open needs active node, derives read write map caps, rejects prealloc with sequential display, and links lazily created shared open state.
Map prechecks cap unlocked then delegates under mutex and active guard, rejecting substitution and mixed ops; VMA wrappers need backend ops.
Seek prefers backend then generic under active guard; poll watches shared generation; notify bumps generation and defers superblock fanout.
Sequential buffers refuse beyond global maximum and double on overflow; zero resets position and divergence triggers rewalk with discard on failure.
End relative seek adds end, zero displacement current query avoids rewrite, hole maps to end, and install rejects negative and over maximum values.
New file nodes keep ops size namespace and cached caps; setattr ignores size, and eviction clears cache and drops reference.
Xattr listing merges ACL and stored entries with size probe and filtering, uses create replace semantics, lazy table, and user quotas with rollback.
Superblock reuse matches root and namespace; anon setup takes nonzero minor from bounded pool; device record holds passive ref; UUID truncates with warning.
Stat uses page geometry and derived id; handles need two words; decode accepts kernfs forms with stale on miss; path output escapes.
Symlink text limited to max path via shared ancestor; simple lookup rejects overlong with delegation and splicing; getattr uses page derived blocks.
Offset cookies in dentry private data use range tree with contention as no space; rename moves cookies and updates counts and times.

locks.text: Per open mutex outside active ref guards backend calls; sequential lock guards iterator buffer and position.
Notify list uses interrupt safe spinlock with duplicate guard; per node open mutex with RCU guards shared state; supers list under write lock.
Attribute writes take root semaphore for write and queries for read; xattr mutation uses node mutex across mounts; enumeration holds read protection.
Device registration needs global superblock lock; kernfs name reads hold filesystem read lock; directory walks use shared inode with nested dentry locks.

state_machines.text: Sequential read validates position, reuses buffer, produces records with skip and doubling restart, packs by demand, then advances or reports fault.
Open flows from active acquisition through setup linkage and backend open to release and staged free; notify flows idle queued deferred until empty.
Xattr update branches on existence and flags keeping hash and list coherent; handle decode validates, looks up with stale, optionally steps to parent.
Cursor zero one are dots with nonnegative seeks; offset iteration emits dots, resolves start by map, advances by cookies, parks at end marker.

structs.text: Kernfs file table offers read write seek map open release poll sync splice; mapping ops offer open fault access; simple and symlink sets are fixed.
Attribute holder keeps ownership times and quota linkage; root keeps allocator supers semaphores and cache; super info binds superblock root and namespace.
